title: Dental Council of NSW
summary: This page provides information about the Dental Council of NSW, which is the body responsible for regulating dental professionals in New South Wales.

internal_links.text: Lodge a complaint about a health care practitioner or service provider

faqs.q: What is the Dental Council of NSW?
faqs.a: The Dental Council of NSW is the body that regulates dental professionals in New South Wales.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about the Dental Council of NSW?
faqs.a: You can visit the Dental Council of NSW website for more information.
